_comment: CUSTOMIZE: Copy this file to config.local.json and review every field below.
_comment_root: CUSTOMIZE: Set the absolute path of the git working tree's top level. Leave it empty to serve the git top level of the directory serve.mjs starts in.
_comment_host: CUSTOMIZE: Set the IP address to listen on. Keep a loopback address; serve.mjs refuses any other address unless --allow-non-loopback is given on the command line.
_comment_port: CUSTOMIZE: Set the TCP port, or 0 for any free port.
